[✨12/26 UPDATE INFO✨]
👉Added Tattoos!!
Once purchased, a tattoo can be used once during your entrance show.
Tattoos can be purchased from the Tattoo Shop.
Not all tattoos are always available — the shop stock refreshes every 5 minutes.
👉Added new costumes!!

Welcome to Dress To Entrance!
Tonight, the crowd is waiting for your exciting wrestler entrance scene!

💡How to Play:
👑Choose and coordinate your outfit according to the theme!
🌟Show off your costume to the fullest when you enter!
👍Give other players' entries a ""Like""!
💥Let's compete for the championship belt with a drop kick!

Thank you for playing! Leave a like if you enjoyed and want updates!
Tags: Dress,Fashion,Dress Mania,Up,Fashion Show,Show off,DTE,Professional Wrestling, Wrestle,Pro-Wrestling, Rumble


Updates on the game has been suspended due to our studio's resource management. If you are interested in participating or be involved in the project, contact us.
